response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0 GROUP BY driverId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m FROM per) SELECT p.driverId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.m AS diff FROM per p JOIN overall o ON o.m IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
